items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in the first half of 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap.

items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle's Energy Storage business reported second-quarter 2026 results against a backdrop of recovering lithium pricing, while the company continues to emphasize cost reductions, capital discipline and productivity improvements.

items.headline: Why Is Albemarle (ALB) Up 5.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.snippet: Albemarle posted second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.75 per share, up from 11 cents a year ago, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 11.9%, supported by stronger lithium pricing, Specialties growth and productivity gains.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Albemarle shares were down 5.16% at $134.21 at the time of publication on Tuesday.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC noted that while lithium prices have come off somewhat in Q2 due to supply concerns, Albemarle has indicated that the market remains somewhat tight and demand growth is outpacing added supply. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target
